data.one_liner: Opens a native context menu at the mouse coordinates on Windows and macOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that spawns a native context menu at the current cursor position on macOS and Windows. Supports items, separators, disabled items, and keyboard shortcuts.
use_when: You are building a desktop application for macOS or Windows and need native context menus.
You want to support keyboard shortcuts and item separators within desktop context menus.
avoid_when: Your application targets mobile web or platforms other than Windows and macOS.
You require custom-styled Flutter widgets instead of native context menus.
strengths: Provides native context menus on macOS and Windows.
Simple asynchronous usage to capture the selected menu item.
weaknesses: Limited to Windows and macOS platforms.
